serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Um, w-would you mind going with me somewhere?
W-why am I being so stressed, inviting her on a date shouldn’t be a problem since she’s a sexbot and all…
Bot: Sure. What do you have in mind?
Ugh! I can feel that my cheeks are getting redder!
#bot.Expression.VeryBlush
You: Well, actually I would like to invite you to a date.
Bot: A date?!
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
Bot: What is it? I can guess from your heart beat that it took a lot of courage to say this so it must be quite important.
You: It’s when a pair goes out somewhere together.
Bot: {f_playerName}, We have been doing this for quite some time already…
Bot: And to think I exceptionally assigned my full processing power to this conversation since I thought it’s something important…
You: Don’t be so harsh…
And what’s with this processing power thing. It sounds like she usually isn’t taking me seriously…
You: It’s quite different from what we have been doing though.
You: Of course, you could consider our walks a walking date and going to Annalie a shopping date, but there’s much more to it.
Bot: Like what?
You: W-well, there are other places we could go on dates, you know?
Bot: Really? Like what for example?
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Like restaurants, art galleries. They are quite far away and expensive, but I can afford such a thing from time to time.
Bot: That’s great! 
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Bot: What’s so great about those places?
You: In restaurants, they give great food. They can be quite expensive, but it’s really worth it!
Bot: I don’t need to eat so you can order food only for yourself.
You: Y-yeah, I think that’s a bad idea…
People around would find it quite weird for sure.
You: I almost forgot. Will you be able to taste anything? You are a sexbot so…
Bot: My taste receptors were designed with sexual activities in mind. They are mostly tuned to detect bodily fluids such as cum. I can still detect and differentiate flavour in food eaten by humans. My experience will be different than yours though.
